name: Thazz'ril's Pick

angles.text: As a miner, you know why Foreman Thazz'ril relies on his enchanted pick to survey minerals across Durotar. He hopes to open new mining prospects once the local timber is cleared.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure basic tools and drive off threats like the Burning Blade Coven. That strengthens the Horde's foothold in the Valley of Trials.

faq.answer: Foreman Thazz'ril oversees labor and resource gathering in the Valley of Trials. He directs peons as they clear timber and prepare the land for mining.
Thazz'ril enchanted his favorite pick to glow in the dark, so it is easier to spot in pitch-black caverns.
The Burning Blade Coven is a dark cave network north of the peon lumber camp in the Valley of Trials.
faq.q: Where is the Burning Blade Coven?

aliases: how did thazzril lose his pick
faq.answer: Thazz'ril left his favorite pick behind while surveying the northern cave for minerals. When he returned, vicious beasts and dark cultists had infested the cavern.
faq.q: How did Thazz'ril lose his pick?

faq.answer: Thazz'ril left the pick deep in the cave, in a subterranean chamber with waterfalls, where he had been surveying the rock walls.
faq.q: Where inside the cave was the pick left?

faq.answer: Thazz'ril plans to find a productive cave to mine after his peons finish cutting down the surrounding timber in the Valley of Trials.
faq.q: What does Thazz'ril plan to do after getting his pick back?

sections.body: Foreman Thazz'ril directs work in the Valley of Trials. He entered the northern cavern to search for mineral veins and left his favorite pick behind. When he returned, vicious beasts and hostile inhabitants had taken over. Now he seeks capable hands to bring back the tool.
sections.title: A Lost Tool

sections.body: Thazz'ril enchanted his favorite pick to glow in the dark, making it easier to use in dim caverns. Its light marks the tool in a waterfall chamber inside the Burning Blade Coven. Dangerous creatures prowl the shadows. Thazz'ril hopes to put the pick back to work and find new mining prospects across the valley.
sections.title: Glow in the Dark

summary: Foreman Thazz'ril needs his enchanted pick back from the northern cavern. Beasts now prowl the Burning Blade Coven, where the glowing tool lies.
